## 变更目的 / Purpose

说明解决的问题和用户价值。Describe the problem and its user value.

## 实现与边界 / Scope

说明主要实现、刻意未包含的内容，以及是否改变公开契约、持久化或网络行为。

Describe the implementation, intentional exclusions, and any changes to public contracts, persistence, or network behavior.

## 验证 / Verification

- [ ] 已新增或更新相关测试。Relevant tests were added or updated.
- [ ] 对应平台的完整测试入口已通过。The complete platform test script passed.
- [ ] 已完成必要的手工验证。Required manual verification was completed.

粘贴测试摘要；若有环境阻塞，请说明原因和复现步骤。

Paste a concise test summary. If the environment blocked a test, include the reason and reproduction steps.

## 隐私与素材 / Privacy and materials

- [ ] 不包含 API Key、私人文档、个人路径或无权公开的文本。No secrets, private documents, personal paths, or unlicensed text are included.
- [ ] 新增网络或持久化行为时，已更新隐私与安全文档。Privacy and security docs were updated for new network or persistence behavior.
- [ ] AI 辅助生成内容已经人工阅读和验证。AI-assisted work was manually read and validated.

## 截图 / Screenshots

涉及界面变化时，请提供经过脱敏且可公开的截图。For UI changes, include a redacted screenshot that is safe to publish.
